name: dvm-packaging
description: Build dell'exe Windows e del binario macOS standalone (build:mac solo su un Mac: arch = quella della macchina, firma ad-hoc) e Linux (build:linux, arch = host). Sorgente: ../src (nessuna copia). Vedi README.md

scripts.build: npm run clean && pkg . --targets node22-win-x64 --output dist/DigitalVisualMixer.exe && node icon.js win
scripts.build:mac: npm run clean && pkg . --targets node22-macos --output dist/DigitalVisualMixer && codesign --force --sign - dist/DigitalVisualMixer && codesign --verify dist/DigitalVisualMixer && node icon.js mac
scripts.build:linux: npm run clean && pkg . --targets node22-linux --output dist/DigitalVisualMixer && node icon.js linux
